findings.summary: docs/system-facts.md is not among the reading's deliverables
findings.evidence: A change outside the listed deliverables widens the scope.

findings.summary: Deferral moves into a dependents reason or test, and the gate does not see it
findings.evidence: dependents_findings (admission.rs:384-385) counts any non-blank `test` or `reason` as present. So an entry such as {name: 'display.rs moved', dependent: 'other crates', reason: 'producer to check for include_str! readers'} passes today and would still pass after this plan. The planned planner.md line tells the planner to put callers in dependents and never to write 'producer to check' in a risk. That steers the deferral into exactly the section the new rule does not scan. Job 20261026-193430-avnq's miss (a reader of display.rs that nobody searched for) is a dependents miss, not a risk miss. The request asks for the whole class to be prevented, not one field of it. Fix: Apply the same `defers_to_producer` helper to each dependent's `test` and `reason`. Emit a major Athena finding at `dependents, dependent N`, or at `risks` if you want one location, and say which. Add corpus cases: a dependent whose reason defers (Refuse) and one whose reason states a found answer (Accept). Add a line to the CHANGELOG and to the doc comment. Criteria 1–4 still hold; this only widens the fields scanned.
findings.location: Approach / Step 1 (risks_findings scans PlanRisk only); admission.rs:383-420 dependents_findings

findings.summary: The broad verbs will refuse ordinary procedural mitigations, and a false positive can stop the job
findings.evidence: With 'producer' + 'must'/'needs to' + 'read'/'confirm'/'look', the planned matcher refuses mitigations such as 'the producer must read the computed figure from the budgets test failure message'. That is this plan's own step 6, written as a mitigation. It also refuses 'the producer must confirm cargo fmt passes'. Neither defers caller or test discovery. planning.rs:437 sets MAX_MECHANICAL_PASSES = 2, and planning.rs:250 stops the job after that, so over-refusal is not cheap. Criterion 3's guard covers only 'The producer runs cargo test', which uses no auxiliary. Fix: Narrow the verbs to discovery: check, verify, search, find, grep, determine, plus 'look for'. Alternatively, require a discovery object near the verb (caller, test, reader, include_str, usage, impact). Add Accept corpus cases for 'the producer must read the computed figure from the budgets test failure' and 'the producer must confirm cargo fmt --check passes'.
findings.location: Decision 2 (verb list: read, review, look, confirm, inspect, find with must, needs to, has to)

findings.summary: The RiskCase shape cannot hold an empty risks list
findings.evidence: RiskCase has single `risk` and `mitigation` strings, so the 'risk-empty-list' case needs either a special representation or a `Vec<(&str, &str)>` field. As planned, the shape is ambiguous. Fix: Make the case field `risks: Vec<(&'static str, &'static str)>`, or keep the empty list in the unit test only and drop it from the corpus table.
findings.location: Step 4 (RiskCase { risk, mitigation }) and case risk-empty-list

summary: I read admission.rs (plan_findings at 172–313, open_questions_findings at 331, dependents_findings at 383 and the test helper plan_findings_for at 870), the plan side of refusal_corpus.rs (2380–2741), planner.md, briefs.rs OPEN_QUESTION_RULE, budgets.rs and planning.rs's MAX_MECHANICAL_PASSES. Everything the plan names exists as it says. The insertion point is right: plan_findings ends with the dependents and open-questions rules, and risks are never checked. PlanRisk is re-exported through `pub use self::plan::*`. The corpus harness (plan_for, question_findings, PlanExpected) has the shape the plan copies. The docs/system-facts.md edit is genuinely needed for system_facts_budgets_match_computed, and it is not a governance file. Its readers are covered by the dependents list. The demonstrations call the real plan_findings, and the refuse cases would fail on the base commit. One soundness gap needs a revision. The plan scans only `risks`, and its new planner.md line sends the planner to put callers in `dependents`. dependents_findings accepts any non-blank reason or test, so a planner who is told not to write "producer to check" in a risk can write it as a dependent's reason. That entry passes the gate unchanged. The same class stays open one field over. Separately, the broad verb list (read, review, look, confirm with must or needs to) will refuse ordinary procedural mitigations. Each false positive costs one of only two mechanical passes before the job stops.
